title: Last Game, Vampire Knight Manga Get New Chapters in August
content: The September issue of Hakusensha 's LaLa magazine revealed on July 24 that both Shinobu Amano 's Last Game manga and Matsuri Hino 's Vampire Knight manga will get new one-shot chapters in the magazine's next issue on August 4.
author: ANN

title: Kujira Anan's 'And Yet, You Are So Sweet ' Manga Ends
content: Kujira Anan 's And Yet, You Are So Sweet ( Na no ni, Chigira-kun ga Amasugiru ) manga ended with the fourth and final part of the manga's 60th and final chapter on July 22. Anan announced on their blog on May 17 that the manga would end in its 60th chapter.
author: ANN

title: Disney’s Twisted Anime Confirms Second Season Release Window
content: Disney has been slowly dipping its toes into the world of anime, with one of the biggest examples of the legendary studio hitting the medium involving the Sith and the Jedi. Star Wars: Visions has three seasons that bring together several different Japanese studios to tell new stories in a Galaxy Far, Far Away.

title: Ryūto's The Faceless Mercenary Wants to Settle Down Light Novels Get Manga Adaptation
content: This year's August issue of Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine announced on July 24 that Ryūto 's The Faceless Mercenary Wants to Settle Down: Homestead at the Edge of the Galaxy ( Faceless Dropout ) light novel series is getting a manga adaptation that will launch in the magazine's next issue on August 25.

title: Berserk Composer Resurrects Anime’s Biggest Track Live
content: Berserk has long been a major franchise in the anime world, placing the spotlight on the dark story of Guts and the unfortunate members of the Band of the Hawk. Unfortunately, the goodwill that has long surrounded the dark manga series isn’t shared by the anime adaptations that have arrived over the years.
